boundary: Pinned fillAes4Rx4 generation only. Capture seed privately, output native Program bytes and retain caller seed. No autonomous hash, architecture choice or physical PPA.
cycle_contract: Four serialized AES rounds per 16-byte beat. The fourth result transfers only with out_valid/out_ready. Ideal request-to-response availability is 4*(OUTPUT_BYTES/16); output stalls and held responses are separate observers.
